newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - FRANCE - LE MONDE MARCH 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - FRANCE - LE MONDE MARCH 10.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- President Jacques Chirac to address the country at 1930 GMT tonight on subjects of youth, employment and education.

-- Appliance manufacturer SEB SA, in sharp contrast to ailing competitor Moulinex, posts healthy profits and has implemented a policy of profit-sharing. In 1996, 254 million francs were distributed to workers.
-- British Airways to group the activities of French subsidiaries TAT and Air Liberte in April ahead of proposed merger. BA to present plans to staff works councils today.
-- Boards of Thomson-CSF and state-owned Thomson SA to meet on Tuesday for a presentation of book of terms and conditions for planned privatisation of state's stake in Thomson-CSF.
